title: Home guide: the elastic band launcher
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Making materials (9E); conservation of energy
source: Written for science/y9 lesson 22 (Home practical guide and safety card: elastic band launcher (portal worksheet; aim along the floor, away from people and animals))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Find out how the pull-back distance affects how far a car travels.
safety: Aim along the floor, away from people and animals
Bands can snap: keep your face away
An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Stretch an elastic band between two chair legs.
Pull the car back 2 cm against the band and let go.
Repeat three times, then for 4, 6 and 8 cm.
Calculate the mean for each distance.
